gs-22612_03.text: Closest pair. Same composition: window wall on the left, a corner, and a second window wall on the right; parquet in a similar tone; the camera matches within a few degrees. The differences: the photo has a cased pillar and bay windows with a sea view, while we have flat four-pane windows and a sky-and-ground shader outside; our sofa (the white block, bottom left) is in the foreground because the solver put it on the wall the photographer stood against. The polish warms the light slightly and changes almost nothing else.

gs-22612_04.text: Good framing: window wall ahead, door on the near left, long blank wall on the right. The plan has two double-hung windows where the photo has one triple window, and our floor is dark herringbone where the photo has light parquet. The bed frame and the floor lamp are in the foreground because the camera stands where the photographer stood, beside the bed the solver placed. The polish is barely visible.

gs-22612_05.text: Same layout idea (closet wall ahead, window on the right wall), but our west wall is plain with one door, whereas the photo shows three closet doors, and the furniture is outside the frame (only the rug edge shows). The camera is right; the room is not the photographed one.

gs-20665_11.text: Fair: window wall ahead, door to the bedroom on the right, cedar ceiling missing (ours is white). The photo's corner window and balcony door do not exist in the plan. The camera was moved 1 m toward the room centre by hand because the photographed room is wider than the plan room. The white box is the plan's fireplace/counter fixture.

gs-20665_13.text: Weak: the photo's room is 4.2 m tall with a fireplace beside the window; our plan room is 2.6 m tall and its fireplace fixture is a plain box. The window and side walls line up roughly. The sofa is in the near foreground.

gs-20665_17.text: Poor, and a useful warning: the photo shows the bedroom's door wall (mirror closet, bath, hall). Our plan engine produced a jagged south wall there with wall stubs and a toilet fixture that leaked into the bedroom, so the render is a corridor of fragments. Camera and polish are fine; the layout is the problem (plan engine issue).
